name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
overview: A national mission for financial inclusion providing universal access to banking facilities, including a basic savings account, RuPay debit card, and access to credit and insurance, for every household.
objectives: Ensure universal access to banking services
Provide access to credit, insurance and pension

benefits.title: Zero-Balance Account
benefits.description: Basic savings bank account with no minimum balance requirement

benefits.title: RuPay Debit Card
benefits.description: Free RuPay card with inbuilt accident insurance cover

benefits.title: Overdraft Facility
benefits.description: Access to a small overdraft facility for eligible account holders

otherCriteria: Any Indian citizen without an existing bank account

customQuestions.question: Are you an adult who does not currently have a bank account?
Do you want to open a Basic Savings Bank Deposit (BSBD) account?
Do you have an Aadhaar number/card?
Is the account being opened as an individual account rather than an institutional account?
Are you willing to open the account through a bank branch or Business Correspondent (Bank Mitra)?

applicationProcess.description: Visit nearest bank branch or Bank Mitra
Fill account opening form with Aadhaar/KYC details
Account opened with RuPay card issued

faqs.question: Is there a minimum balance requirement?
faqs.answer: No, it is a zero-balance account.

faqs.question: What insurance comes with the RuPay card?
faqs.answer: Accidental insurance cover as per scheme terms.

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
overview: A scheme facilitating bank loans between Rs. 10 lakh and Rs. 1 crore to at least one Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe borrower and one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield enterprise.
objectives: Promote entrepreneurship among SC/ST and women
Facilitate access to institutional credit for greenfield enterprises
Provide handholding support to first-time entrepreneurs

benefits.title: Bank Loan
benefits.description: Composite loan between Rs. 10 lakh and Rs. 1 crore for setting up a new enterprise

benefits.title: Handholding Support
benefits.description: Support for pre-loan training, registration and post-loan monitoring

otherCriteria: First-time entrepreneur setting up a greenfield project in manufacturing, services, trading or allied sector

Submit project report and required documents

faqs.answer: Between Rs. 10 lakh and Rs. 1 crore.

faqs.question: Who is eligible?
faqs.answer: SC/ST and women entrepreneurs setting up a greenfield enterprise.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
overview: A scheme providing collateral-free loans up to Rs. 20 lakh to non-corporate, non-farm micro and small enterprises through Shishu, Kishor, Tarun and Tarun Plus categories.
objectives: Provide access to institutional credit for micro enterprises
Support income-generating activities in manufacturing, trading and services
Encourage entrepreneurship among small business owners

benefits.title: Collateral-free Loan
benefits.description: Loans up to Rs. 20 lakh depending on business stage, with no collateral required

otherCriteria: Non-corporate, non-farm micro/small enterprise engaged in income-generating activity

Is the proposed activity not an excluded/non-eligible activity under PMMY/lending-institution rules?

applicationProcess.description: Apply at a bank, NBFC or MFI, or through the Udyamimitra portal
Submit business plan and required documents
MUDRA card issued for working capital, if applicable

faqs.question: What are the loan categories?
faqs.answer: Shishu (up to Rs. 50,000), Kishor (up to Rs. 5 lakh), Tarun (up to Rs. 10 lakh) and Tarun Plus (up to Rs. 20 lakh).

faqs.question: Is collateral required?
faqs.answer: No, loans under PMMY are collateral-free.

name: National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP)
overview: An umbrella social security programme providing financial assistance to elderly, widows and persons with disabilities from below poverty line households through various pension sub-schemes.
objectives: Provide social assistance to poor households in cases of old age, death of breadwinner or disability
Ensure minimum income security for vulnerable groups

benefits.title: Monthly Pension
benefits.description: Central assistance through Old Age Pension, Widow Pension and Disability Pension components

otherCriteria: BPL households with elderly, widowed or disabled members, as per component-wise criteria

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)

ministry.name: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
ministry.department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

overview: A micro-credit scheme providing affordable working capital loans to urban street vendors to resume and grow their businesses, with incentives for timely repayment and digital transactions.
objectives: Facilitate working capital loans to street vendors
Promote formalisation and financial inclusion of street vendors

benefits.title: Working Capital Loan
benefits.description: Initial loan of up to Rs. 10,000, with higher subsequent loans of Rs. 20,000 and Rs. 50,000 on timely repayment

otherCriteria: Urban street vendors in possession of Certificate of Vending or identified in survey

customQuestions.question: Are you a street vendor/hawker engaged in selling goods or providing services to the public?
Are you vending within the geographical limits of an eligible ULB/town/city area?
Do you have a Certificate of Vending (CoV) or Identity Card issued by the ULB/Town Vending Committee?
If you do not have a CoV/ID, can you obtain a Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from the ULB/Town Vending Committee proving that you are a street vendor?
If you were left out of the survey, can you provide acceptable proof that you are a street vendor for obtaining an LoR?
Are you seeking a working-capital loan for your street-vending business?
Can you provide the required identity/KYC documents, such as Aadhaar or another accepted document?

applicationProcess.description: Apply via PM SVANidhi portal or through Urban Local Body/CSC
Repay in installments to become eligible for higher loan tranche

faqs.question: What is the first loan amount?
faqs.answer: Up to Rs. 10,000 as working capital.

faqs.question: What is the benefit of timely repayment?
faqs.answer: Interest subsidy and eligibility for a higher subsequent loan.
